name: Industrial Park Classic
summary: Navy-blue profiled metal sheds with a crisp white office block, as in Vietnam's best-run parks.

design_language.style: contemporary Vietnamese industrial park factory, pre-engineered steel shed with a clean white office block
design_language.primary_material: navy-blue profiled metal wall cladding above a concrete plinth
design_language.secondary_material: white painted steel trims, gutters and canopies
design_language.office_material: white rendered concrete office block with aluminium windows and simple sun shading
design_language.accent: thin yellow or white band at the eave only

environment.weather: clear humid tropical morning with light haze

presentation.landscape_character: rows of tropical shade trees (sao đen, dầu, bàng) along roads and boundaries; trimmed lawn and low hedges at the office forecourt
presentation.paving_character: dark asphalt on every external and perimeter road; light-grey industrial concrete with joints, drainage and light dust on internal yards and loading aprons

brief.roof_type: symmetric low-slope gable profiled-metal roof fitted inside LOD100 envelope
